title: CI: four test jobs, documents-only runs, cancelling superseded runs
decision: Back-end tests are split over four jobs by a hash of the name of the test; a pull request that changes only Markdown under docs, the project records or the root runs the documents job alone, except documents a test reads (the runbooks and schema.sql), and every push to main runs everything; a new push cancels the earlier run of the same pull request
context: Decided by an agent while building what the founder asked for on 2026-10-08; implemented and awaiting his review
rationale: The founder asked for every measure that shortens CI; these three carry little risk and a check in every run proves no test is lost
